saved_rai_runs.origin: Saved RAI Arrow results recovered locally; no live queries in this extension

runs.validation: All memberships, names and internal scores checked with NetworkX Brandes; independent for RAI, consistency check for NetworkX

focus.definition: Local oracle of rules.who_we_are, composite_score and decision_makers: current Northwind Deal Team/Operating Partners; eligible targets with Act 1 score >=70; current CEOs and majority-owning sponsor board designees.
focus.relevance: Internal betweenness sums fractions of shortest paths between other community members that pass through a person, using only the induced subgraph. It does not measure introduction success or real-world influence. All-zero groups have no distinction under this metric. Ties use 3 decimals, then name and ID. Scores and display IDs are specific to each partition.

stability.kind: RAI / NetworkX reference agreement (not an equality requirement)

analysis.metric: Unweighted modularity at resolution 1; adjusted Rand index (1 = identical co-membership, 0 = chance agreement). Also reported without graph isolates.
analysis.caveat: RAI and NetworkX have different tolerances and implementations; equal seeds or level caps do not imply identical partitions. Level caps do not prove convergence. RAI seed stability requires multiple available RAI seeds at the same level cap.
